summary.value: Resolution urging a preventative, interagency, and data-driven approach to ending severe and fatal traffic crashes, with a focus on protecting children, seniors and other vulnerable populations.

citations.quote: Resolution urging a preventative, interagency, and data-driven approach to ending severe and fatal traffic crashes by designing and enforcing safer streets for all San Franciscans, with a particular focus on protecting children, seniors, and other vulnerable populations.
